name: Data Cleaner
description: Performs intelligent data cleaning including missing value handling, duplicate removal, and outlier treatment

environment_variables.name: DATA_FILE
environment_variables.description: Path to the data file to clean

environment_variables.name: HANDLE_MISSING
environment_variables.description: Strategy for missing values - options are 'remove', 'mean', 'median', 'mode', 'smart'

environment_variables.name: OUTLIER_STRATEGY
environment_variables.description: How to handle outliers - options are 'keep', 'remove', 'flag', 'cap'
